programs.name: Bachelor of Science (Computing and Software Systems major)
programs.a_level_offer: BBB (2027 entry score, guide only). At least three A Levels; at least a C in prerequisite subjects.
programs.ib_offer: 31 points (2027 entry score, guide only). At least 4 in English or English B (SL or HL); at least 4 in Analysis and Approaches (SL or HL) or Applications and Interpretations HL; at least 4 in one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics (HL or SL).
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma: unweighted GPA 3.2 plus SAT 1210 or ACT 25 or AP exam aggregate 13 (2027 entry score, guide only). Prerequisites: AP Calculus AB or BC (score 3+) and a lab science (AP Biology or AP Chemistry, or a Physics combination: AP Physics 1 and 2, or 1 and C: Electricity and Magnetism, or C: Mechanics and C: Electricity and Magnetism); a lab science is not needed if both AP Calculus AB and BC are presented. Approved equivalents (e.g. US college dual-enrolment, syllabus reviewed) also count.
programs.required_subjects: English; Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches, or Applications and Interpretations at HL, for IB); one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 81 overall (old 0-120 scale) with writing 19, speaking 19, reading 16, listening 16. The page does not give a score on the new 1-6 scale.
programs.english_note: University of Melbourne English level 1 (Bachelor of Science). Also accepted: PTE Academic 64 (60 in each skill), Cambridge C1 Advanced 169, LanguageCert Academic 67, Michigan English Test 58.
programs.notes: Melbourne has no separate computer science bachelor's degree here: students are admitted to the Bachelor of Science and choose the Computing and Software Systems major, so the entry requirements below are those of the whole Bachelor of Science. The Entry score 2027 values are guide scores that match VCE-equivalent results; the domestic lowest selection rank for 2026 was 91. Fee not stored: Melbourne charges international fees per subject by discipline band, so the course page gives only a range for the whole Bachelor of Science, A$55,556 - A$65,344 for the first year in 2027 (total A$181,310 - A$211,405); the 2027 International Fee Tables list Computing subjects at A$64,608 per 100 credit points (1 EFTSL): https://study.unimelb.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0034/462949/2027-International-Fee-Tables.pdf. Direct applications for the 2027 start-year intake (Semester 1) close 30 November 2026 (international key dates: https://study.unimelb.edu.au/find/courses/undergraduate/bachelor-of-science/how-to-apply/). AP route: https://study.unimelb.edu.au/how-to-apply/undergraduate-study/recognised-vce-equivalent-qualifications/qualifications/united-states-high-school-diploma-and-satact . Major description: handbook https://handbook.unimelb.edu.au/2026/components/b-sci-major-1 (a natural pathway to the Master of Engineering (Software), Master of Science (Computer Science) and Master of Data Science).

programs.name: Bachelor of Commerce (Economics major)
programs.a_level_offer: ABB (2027 entry score, guide only). At least three A Levels; at least a C in prerequisite subjects.
programs.ib_offer: 34 points (2027 entry score, guide only; 35 for 2026 entry). At least 4 in English Language A: Literature, English Language A: Literature and Language, English Literature and Performance or English B (SL or HL); at least 4 in Analysis and Approaches (SL or HL) or at least 4 in Applications and Interpretations HL (Applications and Interpretations SL does not count).
programs.ap_offer: US High School Diploma: unweighted GPA 3.4 plus SAT 1270 or ACT 27 or AP exam aggregate 17 (2027 entry score, guide only). Prerequisite: AP Calculus AB or BC (score 3+), or an approved equivalent (e.g. US college dual-enrolment, syllabus reviewed).
programs.required_subjects: English; Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches, or Applications and Interpretations at HL, for IB)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 81 overall (old 0-120 scale) with writing 19, speaking 19, reading 16, listening 16. The page does not give a score on the new 1-6 scale.
programs.english_note: University of Melbourne English level 1 (Bachelor of Commerce). Also accepted: PTE Academic 64 (60 in each skill), Cambridge C1 Advanced 169, LanguageCert Academic 67, Michigan English Test 58.
programs.notes: Melbourne has no standalone economics bachelor's degree: Economics is a major inside the Bachelor of Commerce (it is also a major in the Bachelor of Arts), so the entry requirements are those of the whole Bachelor of Commerce. The Entry score 2027 values are guide scores that match VCE-equivalent results; the domestic lowest selection rank for 2026 was 92. Fee not stored: Melbourne charges international fees per subject by discipline band, so the course page gives only a range for the whole Bachelor of Commerce, A$56,451 - A$62,464 for the first year in 2027 (total A$180,714 - A$200,139); the 2027 International Fee Tables list Accounting, Administration, Commerce and Economics subjects at A$61,312 per 100 credit points (1 EFTSL): https://study.unimelb.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0034/462949/2027-International-Fee-Tables.pdf. Direct applications for the 2027 start-year intake (Semester 1) close 30 November 2026 (international key dates: https://study.unimelb.edu.au/find/courses/undergraduate/bachelor-of-commerce/how-to-apply/). AP route: https://study.unimelb.edu.au/how-to-apply/undergraduate-study/recognised-vce-equivalent-qualifications/qualifications/united-states-high-school-diploma-and-satact . Major description: https://handbook.unimelb.edu.au/2026/components/b-com-major-4 .

programs.notes: This is a pathway, not an accredited engineering degree: Melbourne offers engineering as Engineering Systems majors (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Civil, Electrical, Chemical, Biomedical, Environmental, Digital Infrastructure) inside the Bachelor of Science; the Mechanical Engineering Systems major description names the Master of Engineering as the route to accredited professional engineering, so the BSc is the first step and accredited engineering needs the Master of Engineering after it (its length was not checked). The Bachelor of Design and Bachelor of Biomedicine also offer engineering majors (per the US-diploma page). Entry requirements below are those of the whole Bachelor of Science (the page lists no extra prerequisite for the engineering majors; check the major in the handbook: https://handbook.unimelb.edu.au/2026/components/b-sci-major-30). Fee not stored: Melbourne charges international fees per subject by discipline band, so the course page gives only a range for the whole Bachelor of Science, A$55,556 - A$65,344 for the first year in 2027 (total A$181,310 - A$211,405); the 2027 International Fee Tables list Engineering subjects at A$64,032 per 100 credit points (1 EFTSL): https://study.unimelb.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0034/462949/2027-International-Fee-Tables.pdf.
